why: A mid-blue midi dress with a light grey blazer is a polished, non-competing guest look that works for both the 15:00 ceremony and the banquet. It has no loud colour, no formality mismatch and no clash near the face. I accept the blandness remarks and the tonal scheme on purpose: a quiet guest outfit is right here, and the brown suede bag adds warmth and texture. I also accept the bust-ease note, which is declared, and the dress price, because the dress is the single dominant piece.
